rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for the physical base of a statue, column, vase, or lamp.

example.english: The pedestal of this table lamp has cracked, so it will not stand steadily.
example.traditional: 呢盞檯燈個底座裂咗，擺唔穩。
example.jyutping: ne1 zaan2 toi2 dang1 go3 dai2 zo6 lit6 zo2 baai2 m4 wan2

rows.note: Use this for a person or thing treated as beyond criticism or placed in a position of special reverence, especially in 捧上神枱.

example.english: They put him on a pedestal as soon as he debuted, so nobody dared criticize anything he did.
example.traditional: 佢一出道就畀人捧上神枱，做乜都冇人敢批評。
